TECHNOLOGY

Technology

OSRM operates one of India's most advanced and technology-driven packaging manufacturing ecosystems, spread across three fully integrated units in Rewa, Madhya Pradesh. Equipped with world-class Starlinger, Lohia Corp and Pelican machinery, our facilities deliver consistent quality, scale, and reliability for global cement packaging needs.

European technology, Indian execution.

From extrusion to conversion, every stage is optimized for efficiency, precision, and high-performance output. Our machinery configuration is specifically designed to meet the rigorous demands of the global cement industry — where dust emission, bag integrity, and filling-line compatibility are non-negotiable.

OSRM has invested in top-of-the-line equipment from leading global suppliers — Starlinger of Austria for tape, conversion and coating; Lohia Corp for high-volume weaving; Pelican Rotoflex of India for flexographic printing; and Polystar for our in-house recycling line.

TAPE STRETCHING · 2 LINES

Starlinger STAREX 1600ES

720 KG/HR throughput · Auto Die · BST Thickness Measurement · Auto Knife Changer · Gravimetric Batch Blender · Stacotape 200xe winding with Central Tension Control.

WEAVING · HIGH-VOLUME LOOMS

Lohia Corp Nova 6

Hundreds of circular looms operating in parallel for round-the-clock fabric weaving. Uniform tension control and high tape pick density for premium fabric quality.

CONVERSION · 4 LINES

Starlinger AD*STARKON SX+ 120

Up to 140 bags per minute · Booster Technology for valve patch pasting · Microstar+ bilateral micro-perforation at 83 needles/cm² for reduced dust emission, higher tenacity, and improved air permeability.

CONVERSION · NEXT-GEN LINE

Starlinger AD*STARKON Neo

The latest generation conversion technology from Starlinger — higher throughput, lower energy consumption, and refined valve and seam quality. Sets the new global benchmark for cement-bag conversion.

COATING · 2 LINES

Starlinger LAMITEC LX

With BOPP attachment · Vacuum Feeder & Elliptic Dosing Unit · Edge Sensor for Transparent Fabric · Corona Pretreating Device with Ceramic Electrodes · Micro-perforation at lamination level.

PRINTING · 4 PRESSES

Pelican Rotoflex Flexographic Presses

1× 8-colour printing press · 3× 6-colour presses · Viscosity Controller for consistent print across long production runs. Razor-sharp reproduction of cement brand logos and regulatory text.

RECYCLING · IN-HOUSE

Polystar Repro Line

Closed-loop polypropylene recycling · SPB melt filter with hydraulic back-flushing — up to 720 kg/hour throughput · Enables 50%+ recyclate in tape production without quality degradation.
